data.name: Vivak
data.gender_notes: Vivak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vivak is a Sanskrit and Hindu name, derived from the root 'Vij' meaning knowledge. It signifies intelligence, wisdom, and insight. This name is suitable for a child who is destined to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual. The name Vivak carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vivak usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vivak is a spiritual name that represents the inner wisdom and knowledge that resides within each one of us. It is a reminder to tap into our inner source of wisdom and guidance.
data.etymology: Vivak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vivak total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vivak reflects the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism, which values wisdom and knowledge above material possessions. It is a name that is deeply rooted in the philosophy of ancient India, where the pursuit of knowledge was considered the highest form of learning. Vivak is a name that embodies the spirit of the great sages and thinkers of India, who dedicated their lives to the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Vivak holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name connects the person bearing it to the divine source of all knowledge and wisdom, the Supreme Consciousness. Vivak is a reminder of the inner wisdom and intelligence that resides within each one of us, and it is a call to pursue knowledge and wisdom throughout our lives. By embracing the name Vivak, one is making a commitment to the path of self-realization and spiritual growth.
